why.missing_target: invocationTarget names an Apex class or Flow that is not in the project, or an Apex class with no @InvocableMethod. Consequence: there is nothing for the planner to invoke (inferred).
why.target_inactive: the Flow behind the action is not Active. Consequence: an inactive Flow cannot be launched by an action (inferred).
why.no_planner_output: no output property is marked copilotAction:isUsedByPlanner. Consequence: the GenAiFunction reference states the planner returns random responses (documented).
why.dangling_topic_function: a topic lists a functionName that is not an action in the project. Consequence: the topic promises an action the planner cannot find (inferred).
why.orphan_input: the input schema declares a property the target has no variable for. Consequence: the planner collects a value that is silently dropped (inferred).
why.uncovered_input: the target accepts an input the schema never declares. Consequence: the planner can never supply it, so the target always sees null (inferred).
why.missing_required_input: an @InvocableVariable(required=true) has no property in the schema at all. Consequence: the planner can never supply a value Apex insists on (inferred).
why.required_not_enforced: an @InvocableVariable(required=true) is in the schema but not in its required list. Consequence: the planner may call the action without a value Apex insists on (inferred).
why.type_mismatch: a schema property and the target variable of the same name disagree on type. Consequence: validation is weakened, widened or lost at the boundary (inferred).
why.orphan_output: the output schema declares a property the target never produces. Consequence: the planner reasons over a field that is always empty (inferred).
why.text_cap_exceeded: a text property declares maxLength above the documented cap of 250. Consequence: the reference caps text types at 250 characters (documented).
why.unreachable_action: no topic lists the action. Consequence: the planner never sees it; the action is dead metadata (inferred).

note: severity decides the exit code: fatal fails by default, warn fails under --strict, info never fails; fail_on_undecidable makes an unchecked property fail the build
